source_metadata.source_type: narrative review article with supplementary appendix

batch_manifest.scope: summary, disease definition, classification, driver prevalence
phylogeny, clonal fitness mutations, germline predisposition
current treatment, interferon, JAK inhibitors, treatment limits
mutant CALR and JAK2-directed emerging therapies, Tables 1-2
supplementary pathophysiology, anemia/PV therapies, risk and symptom scores

notes: Overlapping summary/conclusion language was retained only when it served a distinct section-level assertion.
Secondary quantitative statements were not converted into primary-study quantitative_result atoms when the review did not supply a schema-faithful estimate/context.

schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated narrative_review_claim or secondary_reported_result atom kind. Review-derived assertions therefore use other, author_conclusion, limitation, intervention_description, or outcome_definition plus explicit secondary-source tags.
extraction_limitations: This is a narrative review, not a primary study; atoms represent assertions made by the review and do not establish the cited primary studies as independently verified evidence.
The interactive NEJM graphic referenced in the article was not present in the retrieved PDFs and was not atomized.
Pure bibliography entries were excluded from atomization and instead routed to the separate reference task queue.
Approximate or inequality-based secondary results were preserved in canonical text rather than forced into QuantitativeResult fields that require exact scalar estimates.
